desc: 霜白墨青冷调棚拍、独立小包开袋即食的休闲零食版面
leaf: 开袋即食独立小包蜜饯枣
name: 墨青冷调开袋即食蜜枣款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里以冷调干净底色一眼抓住点击，交代开袋即食的包装形态
用侧面微距证明果料真实、质地软糯有纹理，而非塑料感仿品
让上班族代入工位解馋的真实时刻，确立开袋即食的食用方式
放大普通大袋装受潮、洒落、不好带、拿取粘手的日常摩擦
用同机位同光的两种码放状态，直观证明分量整齐与干净程度
shots.textZone: one blank rounded label pill above each half, top left and top right

shots.intent: 让买家在一屏内看到可选的独立小包排列与口味差异，标签留空由商家填
shots.textZone: one short caption slot under each pack along the lower band

shots.intent: 承接详情页的参数表结构，数值一律留空由商家后期填入
shots.textZone: right column, four empty parameter rows with one short caption each

shots.intent: 把即食小包放进通勤与户外歇脚的真实情境，强化随身解馋的购买理由
以可见封口压纹与留空的凭证框降低风险感，资质数值全部后期合成
shots.textZone: one short caption inside the corner bracket, one unfilled stamp frame at the lower band

shots.intent: 以一组产品加一个空白按钮位收口，引导下单但不给任何优惠数字
shots.textZone: one blank button-shaped placeholder at the lower right, headline area across the top

style.backgroundSystem: seamless frost grey-white plaster field #EDF1F3 for packshots, info screens and scenes; one hard-edged flat deep ink-teal panel #1E2F38 for macro and close; a frosted glass sheet plane for detail; flat geometric blocks only, no pattern, no ornamental border, no scalloped or wave motif
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in berry magenta #A63D6E, one icon per callout, geometric outline only, no seals, no badges, no medal ribbons
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K even studio light, one large soft source camera-left with a white bounce card on the shadow side, soft-edged contact shadows that always ground the product, no warm cast and no dramatic top light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool minimal modern-snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost grey-white field #EDF1F3, deep ink-teal panel #1E2F38, one berry magenta accent #A63D6E and slate text #4A5158; cool 6000K even studio lighting with one large soft source camera-left, a white bounce card on the shadow side and soft-edged contact shadows that ground every piece, no warm cast; flat geometric background system of seamless plaster field, one hard-edged ink-teal block and one frosted glass sheet, no pattern and no ornamental border; surfaces limited to frosted glass, brushed stainless steel, matte melamine and pale stone-grey board #C8CFD4, never linen, gauze, jute, wood or blue-and-white porcelain; modern geometric sans-serif in one family only, Chinese copy rendered only inside corner brackets, all numbers and values left blank for post compositing; thin single-weight line icons in berry magenta, one icon per callout, no seals and no badges; the product stays at a stable scale as one upright pack or one loose single layer with its label rectangle left empty; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no ornamental wave or scallop motifs, no warm amber grading, no inconsistent lighting, no cluttered props.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no fourth hue
no mixed fonts and no brush calligraphy
no ornamental wave, scallop or cloud pattern anywhere
no warm amber grade, no vintage paper or rice-paper texture
no inconsistent lighting and no missing contact shadow
no linen, jute, wood or blue-and-white porcelain props
style.presentationRules: the product reads either as one upright standing pack or as one loose single layer of pieces at a stable scale across the set; every pack shows only an empty rectangular label area whose artwork is carried entirely by {product_identity_lock}
style.surfaceSystem: frosted glass sheet, brushed stainless steel bar, matte melamine slab and pale stone-grey board #C8CFD4; no linen, gauze, jute, raffia, wood board, bamboo or blue-and-white porcelain
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only; Chinese copy rendered only inside corner brackets as placeholders, headline and label sizes fixed per tier, all values and numbers left blank for post compositing
